context: In a classroom separation experiment, a screen retained large leaf fragments while water and sand passed through. A paper filter then retained the sand, but dissolved salt remained in the water. Students heated the filtered salt water in an open dish to evaporate the water and collect the salt. The filter separated suspended particles; it did not remove the dissolved salt.
